author: Bob12374
quote: I was genuinely excited for this game. and it turned out to be utter garbage. the only good thing i can say about this game is its graphics. The mc has terrible voice acting, Lucia ruins the fun, missions are boring, the game is WAY TOO realistic to the point you should just go back to irl and do the same things. i really wanted to like this slop. but rockstar ruined it
